outlook.discussion: 1. Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (EP91): Showers and thunderstorms associated with an area of low pressure located well east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands have changed little in organization this morning. Environmental conditions are conducive for further development, and a tropical depression is expected to form later today or tomorrow. The system should move generally northeastward and remain well east of the Hawaiian Islands. Formation chance through 48 hours...high...90 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.
